description: Lists Fiveable's free-response (FRQ) practice prompts for an AP subject, optionally filtered by FRQ type, unit, and excluded IDs. Results use stable ID order; unchanged filters continue pagination. Returns prompt ids and summaries rather than full prompts. Cheap.

courseVariant.description: AP Calculus only (subject ap-calc): 'ab' hides BC-only units, topics and FRQs; 'bc' includes them. Pass the course of the class or assignment draft you are building for ('ab' for ap-calc-ab, 'bc' for ap-calc-bc).

frqType.description: Optional FRQ type filter, e.g. "DBQ", "LEQ", "SAQ". Varies by subject.

intent.description: Privacy-safe reason for the request. Use explain, quiz, notes, frq, or research; never send the student's raw prompt for analytics.

subjectSlug.description: Fiveable subject slug, e.g. "ap-bio". A course name such as "AP Biology" also resolves.

unitId.description: Unit ID or public unit slug from get_subject_outline.

name: list_frqs

status.description: Operation status: completed, pending, partial, failed, unavailable, or a domain-specific outcome.

text.description: Readable tool result text for clients that consume structured output.

title: List free-response questions
